hints.title: Height Sorting
hints.text: Trees must be cut in strictly ascending order of height. First gather and sort all coordinates of trees with height greater than one.

hints.title: Shortest Path Between Consecutive Trees
hints.text: Start at position (0, 0) and sequentially calculate the shortest distance to each sorted tree using breadth-first search.

hints.title: Step Summation and Unreachability
hints.text: For each consecutive target tree, find the minimal path length avoiding obstacles. If any target is unreachable, return negative one immediately. Otherwise, accumulate the steps.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Sort trees by height and run BFS shortest path between consecutive tree locations.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Greedily jumping to nearest trees violates the required ascending height order.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running standard BFS per tree transition consumes O(M * N) space per path.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify that tree order is deterministic and decompose the problem into repeated BFS pathfinding queries.
